applicability: Any two positive numbers: round each to the nearest ten and multiply for a one-step estimate. When BOTH numbers round the same way the estimate is a guaranteed bound on that side - both rounded up gives an over-estimate, both rounded down gives an under-estimate.
carry_case: When the two numbers round in OPPOSITE directions (one up, one down), the two rounding errors partly cancel: the estimate is usually tighter but can land either above or below the true product, so the 'which side am I on' rule no longer holds. Example: 47 x 43 -> 50 x 40 = 2000, yet the true value is 2021, so the estimate is below the answer even though 47 was rounded up.
